title: Patient Care Desk Guidance — Kestrel Care Rewards Missing Points Claims
content:
Points missing from a purchase are credited to a **Kestrel Care Rewards** membership as a missing-points claim only when all three of the following conditions hold:

1. **Lookback window.** The claim is made no later than the date of the purchase plus the receipt lookback days, counted in calendar days with the purchase date as day 0. The last day of the window itself still qualifies.
2. **Claim allowance.** The number of missing-points claims credited to the membership in the rolling 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the day of the claim is below the level's claim allowance.
3. **The purchase itself.** The purchase is on the patient's own receipt and earned nothing.

**Amount credited.** The points credited are those the purchase would have earned at the level held on the purchase date.

## Lookback window and claim allowance by level

| Level | Receipt lookback (calendar days after the purchase date) | Missing-points claims allowed in any rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | 30 | 3 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Silver | 30 | 3 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 30 | 4 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 60 | 6 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Monthly | 60 | 6 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Plus Annual | 60 | 6 |

## Counting the window (hypothetical dates)

The purchase date is day 0, and the window's last day is the purchase date plus the lookback days.

| Purchase date (day 0) | Lookback | Last day a claim qualifies | Claim on that day | Claim on the next day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 May | 30 days | 2 June | qualifies | outside the window |
| 3 May | 60 days | 2 July | qualifies | outside the window |

## Condition table

| Within the lookback window | Claims in the rolling 365 days below the allowance | Own receipt, purchase earned nothing | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | credited as a missing-points claim |
| no | any | any | not credited |
| any | no | any | not credited |
| any | any | no | not credited |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

- A member at Kestrel Care Rewards Gold has had 3 missing-points claims credited in the last 365 days. 3 is below the allowance of 4, so the allowance condition holds. With 4 claims already credited, it does not.
- A member at Kestrel Care Rewards Silver has had 3 claims credited in the last 365 days. 3 is not below the allowance of 3, so no further claim is credited until the rolling count falls below 3.
- A purchase that already earned points does not meet the third condition, because the purchase must have earned nothing.
- A purchase on someone else's receipt does not meet the third condition, because the receipt must be the patient's own.
- A purchase made while the membership was at Kestrel Care Rewards Silver, claimed after the membership has moved to Kestrel Care Rewards Gold, is credited with the points it would have earned at Silver, the level held on the purchase date.
